profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer & Architect at Tricentis
profile.summary:
Objective:
Pursuit of a Software Engineering management/architect position that fosters innovation, collaboration and learning. 

Expertise & traits:
People leader with strong technical "full-stack" software experience with focus on API design & microservice architecture, proponent of spec-driven development, solid background in Object-Oriented software design, clean code, and agile software development (e.g., TDD), advocate of 12-factor methodology, supporter of FOSS, lead by example, methodical, quick learner, goal-oriented, team player, on constant lookout for innovative, practical technologies & methodologies that can make us more efficient as software organizations.

Technologies & Methodologies:
SAFE/Scrum
UML, ER, OOP, AOP, MVC/P
Cloud-native, Client/Server, Multi-tiered, Distributed, Microservice architecture, AWS
J2EE, Spring, Hibernate, JAXP, JAXRS, REST, SOAP, Thrift, XACML, Swagger, RAML, RabbitMQ, JAAS, OSGi, PKI, OAuth2, SAML, JWT, Kafka, Spark, Hadoop
GWT, Servlet, Lift, WSGI, XML/JSON, XSLT
DB2, Oracle, MySQL, NoSQL, OR/M, JDBC
Java, Scala, Golang, C/C++, SQL, Javascript, Python, Ruby, Bash
SDN, Openflow, OVS, Yang, SAN, NAS, TCP/IP, HTTP, UDP
JUnit, embedded J2EE, Clover, Emma, Ant, Maven
JBoss, WebLogic, Virgo, Karaf, Tomcat, Jetty, NginX, Flask
Windows, Linux, OSX, Containers (Docker), Kubernetes, OpenShift

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Architect
positions.description:
Responsible for the architecture, design and delivery of new product features for Tricentis Unified Test Management (qTest).  The product is globally available as a multi-tenant SaaS and on-prem (Kubernetes, VMs). 
• Transformed qTest into a cloud-native application while adopting a microservice architecture approach and 12-factor app principles.
• Led qTest adoption of Agentic AI and MCP (Model Context Protocol) to eliminate mundane QA tasks, expedite testing, and improve overall test coverage with AI, such as intelligent test gap analysis and test case generation.
• Led qTest adoption of API-first strategy.
• Led company-wide adoption of event-driven architecture with NATS.
• Work with Product Management to establish architectural runway for new features and lead global engineering teams (7) on the delivery of those features.
• Work across Tricentis to ensure seamless and secure cross-product integration.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager / Architect
positions.description:
• Data-driven automation:  Lead a team of engineers to design, develop and deploy a data-driven automation framework to automate auto insurance rating (microservices) across states in a multi-region PCF environment.
• API-First:  Evangelize and champion API-First strategy, tooling, and automation (CI/CD) across the enterprise from CIO to architects and developers.
• Big data & deep-learning:  Lead a team of engineers to architect, design, and develop an event-driven big-data solution to provide an end-to-end visibility into the customer's journey for better business insights and outcomes.

positions.title: Cloud Architect
positions.description: Responsible for leading API-first methodology and API management and cloud security strategy and solution within DXC Cloud and Platform Services organization, which provides customers with turn-key public, private, and hybrid cloud services from IaaS to PaaS and SaaS across various cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google, VMware, Alibaba, etc).

positions.title: Cloud Architect
positions.description:
HPE Helion Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) provides IaaS and PaaS solutions across hybrid cloud environments.  My work as an architect at HPE Helion VPC includes:

•	Architected, designed and implemented a distributed, highly-available/scalable API Gateway solution to provide secure, multi-tenant IaaS & PaaS API access across Europe, North Americas and Asia Pacific.
•	Architected and designed a distributed, highly-scalable ABAC/RBAC authorization framework for hybrid clouds (US Patent pending)
•	Architected and designed a distributed, highly-scalable API Call Detail Record (CDR) system for hybrid clouds (applications include billing, compliance checking, etc.)
•	Designed and drove adoption of microservice architecture across HP Helion VPC components
•	Drove containerization and continuous integration/delivery of HP Helion VPC components
•	(ReSTful) API management evangelist & governance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
During these years, I played software development and tech-lead roles across various disciplines (server, storage, networking, cloud) within HP:

HP Networking (2012 – 2015)
•	OpenDaylight AAA Project Team Lead
•	Manageability & API Lead for the HP VAN SDN controller project.
•	Designed the HP VAN SDN Controller v2.0 OpenFlow REST APIs
•	Designed a dynamic, interactive REST API documentation system (RsDoc)
•	REST API consultant for HPN SDN lab

HP Cloud Services (2010 – 2012)
•	Web Service (REST) API Lead.  Designed HPCS Identity REST API v2.0
•	FOSS contributor to Openstack Keystone
•	Responsible for establishing design principles for RESTful web services for the HP IdM (Identity Management) service for the Cloud.
•	OSGi expert (Apache Felix/iPOJO, Eclipse Equinox/Virgo)

HP Server Automation (2009 – 2010)
•	J2EE Technical Lead
•	Responsible for the design and implementation of the data model to capture VMware and Hyper-V virtualization information.
•	Drove a UI initiative towards a thin web client using GWT, with backward compatibility with the existing Swing-based UI.

HP File Archiver (2008 – 2009)
•	Project Lead
•	Responsible for the design of the entire stack of data tier, application tier, web tier and client tier of the central management server (J2EE and Web Service-based).

HP CSF-R (Content Services Framework-Repository)  (2007 – 2008)
•	Designed & implemented a distributed whole-object single-instancing store.
•	Designed & implemented a distributed throttling engine to help ensure QoS.  This was presented as a paper in HP TechCon 2010.

HP File Gateway (2004 – 2007)
•	J2EE and database Technical Lead
•	Designed end-to-end distributed application (from JSP/Servlet to EJB/JMX to data model)
•	I18N Champion

HP Openview Storage Area Manager (1999 – 2004)
•	Led a team of 5 Java developers through the SDLC of OV-SAM Storage Builder (capacity management)

HP IA-64 Architecture (1998 – 1999)
•	Wrote a system simulator in C to verify IA-64 architecture.

positions.title: Project Team Lead
positions.description:
At OpenDaylight (open-source SDN platform), I served as Project Team Lead (PTL) for the AAA (Authentication, Authorization, and Audit) project to provide security and audit capabilities for all OpenDaylight applications. Key responsibilities include:

•	Lead a team of developers from various companies (HP, Cisco, Innocybe, RedHat, Brocade) through the architecture, design and implementation of AAA.
•	Provide integration guidance for other OpenDaylight projects (DLUX, RestConf, MD-SAL, etc...)
•	Scrum master!
•	Participated in OpenDaylight simultaneous release program
•	Advocated and adopted Apache Karaf for better application management and deployment over the existing Apache Felix container.  ODL currently runs on Karaf.

patents.title: Localization cataloguing tool
patents.description: A code arrangement for facilitating the localization of an information source comprising a collector module for collecting information units to be localized from the information source and for causing a copy of the information units to be localized, a synchronization module for receiving the localized information units and comparing each to a current version of the information unit from the information source to determine if the information unit has changed and a dispersing module for storing the localized information unit if the information unit is unchanged. A related processor and method may include features similar to the elements of the code arrangement.

patents.title: Method and apparatus for detecting file system corruption
